settings.description: The bot's token from the Discord developer portal.

connectors.summary: List a Discord server's text channels, read their messages, save attachments as artifacts, and post plain-text messages as a bot.
connectors.title: Discord

tools.description: List the Discord conversations the connector can read: id, kind (direct, group or channel) and title. Use next_page_token to continue.
tools.name: discord.list_conversations

items.description: A chat, group or channel the connector can read or write.

tools.description: List recent Discord messages in one conversation, newest first: conversation, sender, time, text and attachments (with the ids get_attachment takes). tools.description: Send one plain-text message to a Discord conversation as the deployment's own account. reply_to_message_id answers a message from list_messages. Every call posts a real message.
